marked_text:
Sadbarg Qodirova, the kiln-log clerk, stayed after the firing at the yard in Dushanbe and copied the carbon before it dried. Vendor [[vendor]]Sarioz Gauge House[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]SG-3184[[/]]. They want [[total]]1,460.75[[/]] somoni for the thermocouple that arrived taped to a plank. The only date on the page is [[issued]]11 August 2026[[/]]. STAMP: SANJIDA, red, walking into the margin. She pencilled лутфан имрӯз because the driver would not wait on the ramp. Old docket SG-8830 was a probe we sent back and is not this charge. The copy roller split cra-
te across the crease. Grease thumb in the box, no buyer code typed anywhere on this slip.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Shop that sent the kiln slip

ask.name: bill_no
ask.instruction: Bill number printed on the slip

ask.name: total
ask.instruction: Money total copied from the slip

ask.name: issued
ask.instruction: Date written on the slip

ask.name: buyer_code
ask.instruction: Buyer code if one was typed

marked_text:
Orazgeldi Nuryyev, loom fitter, wrote this after the carpet line in Ashgabat snapped a shuttle just before dusk. Vendor [[vendor]]Yelken Belt Loft[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]YB-5520[[/]]. Margin charges, in the order he heard them: [[charge]]shuttle brake[[/]], [[charge]]loom belt[[/]], [[charge]]night callout[[/]]. The figure copied beside the stamp is [[amount]]890.40[[/]] manat. Issued [[issued]]6 July 2026[[/]] with [[credit]]17[[/]] credit days, and he left the due day off the page on purpose. A short line in Turkmen says töleg wagtynda. The tear splits sha-
ft onto the next line. Prior quote YB-4475 was another loom and stays unmarked. Oil smear, stamp crooked, corner chewed.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Loft that issued the bill

ask.name: bill_no
ask.instruction: Bill number on the loft copy

ask.name: charges
ask.instruction: Each charge named in the margin

ask.name: amount
ask.instruction: Amount copied beside the stamp

ask.name: pay_by
ask.instruction: Issue date plus the credit days

ask.instruction: Date the bill was issued

marked_text:
Lucie Boula, sample runner, carried the cooler from the lab shed to the quay at Noumea while the squall sat on the reef. Vendor [[vendor]]Anse Vata Runners[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]AV-5528[[/]]. The note opens on [[opened]]11 March 2027[[/]] and allows [[wait]]18[[/]] days, yet the day that follows that wait is not written. Copied fee [[fee]]734.60[[/]] francs for the cooler and the ferry hop. Blotter French: règlement dès que possible. STAMP: NICKEL, red, half across the crease. The pen skipped and split coo-
ler. Sister slip AV-7731 was a harbour quote she refused. No customs entry is named on this page at all.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Runner who billed the quay job

ask.name: bill_no
ask.instruction: Bill number on the sample note

ask.name: settle_on
ask.instruction: Start date plus the allowed days

ask.name: fee
ask.instruction: Fee copied from the note

marked_text:
Heiarii Teriitahi, ice runner, counted bags before dawn at the co-op shed in Papeete while the lagoon was still dark. Vendor [[vendor]]Motu Ice & Salt[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]FA-2633[[/]]. Labour is [[hours]]4.5[[/]] hours times [[rate]]37.20[[/]] francs, and that product was left off the carbon. Hatch closed at [[shut]]6:15 pm[[/]]. The date line says [[dated]]19 October 2026[[/]]. Loaded: [[item]]flake ice[[/]], [[item]]salt sack[[/]], [[item]]crate liner[[/]]. French scrawl: glace déjà fondue. The perforation splits lin-
er. Old total 240.15 from a cancelled run is still faint and is not this job. Salt crust on the stamp and the hinge.

ask.instruction: Cold room that wrote the ticket

marked_text:
Fabiola Maduro, winch rigger, wrote this on the pontoon at Oranjestad after the drum seized in the swell. Vendor [[vendor]]Paardenbaai Wire Works[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]PB-7712[[/]]. She logged the call as [[logged]]3 November 2026 4:40 pm[[/]]. Gross on the slate is [[gross]]612.80[[/]] florin and the credit slip says [[credit]]148.35[[/]], but the difference was never copied onto the page. Service date underneath: [[served]]28 October 2026[[/]]. Papiamento in the margin: fabor paga awe. Grease splits win-
ch across the smear. Earlier quote 508.90 was a different sheave and remains unmarked. Stamp BAY tilted, rope fibre in the ink.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Yard that sent the winch bill

ask.name: bill_no
ask.instruction: Bill number on the pontoon copy

ask.name: logged_at
ask.instruction: When the seizure was logged

ask.name: balance
ask.instruction: Slate gross minus the credit slip

ask.name: served
ask.instruction: Service date under the log line

marked_text:
Kenisha Deterville, tally clerk, counted the afternoon load at the warehouse in Castries while rain hit the zinc roof. Vendor [[vendor]]Vigie Bond Stores[[/]]. Bill [[bill]]VN-6408[[/]]. Three amounts on the slate: [[part]]52.30[[/]], [[part]]18.45[[/]], and [[part]]27.60[[/]], and nobody wrote what they add up to. Lines beside them: [[line]]nutmeg bags[[/]], [[line]]mace tins[[/]], [[line]]crate straps[[/]]. An old figure 215.70 was quoted on a rejected card and is not marked. Docket date [[posted]]22 September 2026[[/]]. Kwéyòl in the corner: tanpri péyé. The staple tears do-
cket. Violet stamp smudged, drip at the edge.

ask.name: vendor
ask.instruction: Bond house that issued the docket

ask.name: bill_no
ask.instruction: Bill number on the warehouse docket

ask.name: slate
ask.instruction: The three slate amounts added

ask.name: lines
ask.instruction: Each goods line named beside the amounts

ask.name: posted
ask.instruction: Date written on the docket
